feralGreetHostile: {name} puts a table between the two of you. "Whose {kind} is this? Somebody's, I hope."
"Out," {name} says, without taking their eyes off you. "Out. Out."
{name} reaches slowly for something heavy. "Nice {kind}. Stay exactly there, {kind}."
"I have been bitten before," says {name}. "I know how this starts."
{name} does not blink. "If that thing has an owner, they should be ashamed of themselves."
"Whatever you are," {name} says, "you are not welcome in here."
feralGreetWary: {name} keeps their distance. "Is it tame? Is anybody's {kind} ever tame?"
"Easy," {name} says, to the {kind} rather than to anyone holding it. "Easy, now."
{name} looks past you for whoever ought to be holding a leash.
"Well," says {name}. "That is a {kind}, in a doorway, looking at me."
{name} holds very still, the way people do around animals they cannot read.
"I am not frightened of it," {name} says, from behind a chair.
feralGreetWarm: "Oh, what a cute {kind}!" {name} says, and means it.
{name} crouches down at once. "Hello. Hello, you. Who is a good {kind}?"
"I have never been this close to a {kind}," says {name}, delighted.
{name} offers the back of a hand to be sniffed, and is patient about it.
"You are a handsome thing," {name} tells you. You understand the tone, if not the words.
{name} brightens. "Come here. Come on. Nobody minds a {kind}."
feralGreetAdoring: "There you are!" says {name}. "The best {kind} in this whole town."
{name} is already digging in a pocket for something you might eat.
"Everybody, look who it is," {name} announces, to nobody at all.
{name} scratches exactly the right spot behind your ear without being asked.
"They tell me you are dangerous," {name} says fondly. "They have never met you."
{name} sits down on the floor so that you do not have to look up.
feralReactHostile: {name} backs off a full step. "That is quite enough of that."
"Somebody get this {kind} out of here," {name} says to the room.
{name} keeps the table between you and does not look away.
"I knew it," says {name}. "I said so, and I was right."
{name} looks for a door, and it is not the one you are standing in.
feralReactWary: {name} freezes until it is over. "All right. All right."
"I do not know what that meant," {name} says, "and I would rather not."
{name} laughs, one note, and it is not a comfortable one.
{name} decides, visibly, to stay exactly where they are.
feralReactWarm: {name} laughs properly. "You are ridiculous. Look at you."
"Yes, yes," {name} says, scratching behind your ear. "I heard you."
{name} answers in the same tone you used, which is fair enough.
"That is the most anybody has said to me all day," says {name}.
{name} does not flinch at all. That is new.
feralReactAdoring: "Oh, you are the finest {kind} alive," {name} says, quite seriously.
{name} laughs until they have to sit down.
{name} would fight this whole town for you, and everybody here knows it.
"Do not let anyone tell you that you are only a {kind}," {name} says.
feralActGrowl: You pull your lip back and let the sound build in your chest.
A low note, all warning and no words.
You growl until the air in the room changes.
Something old and flat comes up out of your throat.
You show them what you have instead of an argument.
feralActRoar: You put everything you have into one enormous noise.
You roar. Crockery answers from a shelf somewhere behind them.
The sound leaves you and takes the conversation with it.
You bellow, and the room is briefly a great deal smaller.
You announce yourself the only way you know how.
feralActDrool: You let a long thread of it reach the floor. It takes a while.
A slow, glistening statement of intent.
Your jaw slackens, and the rest follows.
You leave a small warm puddle as a gift.
feralActSniff: You take a long draught of them: sweat, bread, iron, fear.
You sniff at their hands, then their sleeves, then their boots.
You read them the only way that has ever worked.
You breathe them in and learn where they have been all morning.
You put your nose where a person would have put a question.
feralActNuzzle: You push your head under their hand until it stays there.
You lean your whole weight against their leg.
You bump your muzzle against them, gently, twice.
You rest your chin on them and let it get heavy.
You press into them the way your kind says please.
feralActBeg: You sit. You look up. You do not blink.
You make the small wretched noise that has always worked.
You put a paw where they will have to notice it.
You stare at their hands until they remember what is in them.
You beg with your entire body, shamelessly.
manaCyborgBotLines: LOGGED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR COMPLIANCE.
THAT UNIT DOES NOT HOLD THAT RECORD.
beastActPet: You run a hand along its back, slowly, the way you would want it done.
You scratch it behind the ear until one back leg forgets itself.
You crouch and let it decide, and it decides, and leans in.
You rub the flat of your palm over its head. It shuts its eyes.
You smooth the fur down along its neck, once, twice, again.
You put a careful hand out. It pushes up into it and stays.
beastCollected: You take what the {kind} had ready: {items}.
beastCollectNothing: The {kind} has nothing for you today.
beastJoinRefused: The {kind} backs off a step and will not be coaxed.
beastJoinAccepted: The {kind} falls in at your heel.
beastFedWell: The {item} is gone before you have finished lowering your hand.
It eats the {item} the way a thing eats that has been hungry a while, then looks for more.
It works through the {item} without once looking away from you, which is either trust or accounting.
The {item} goes down whole. It leans against your leg afterwards, heavily.
beastFedPlain: It takes the {item}, chews, swallows, and waits to see whether that was all.
The {item} is eaten politely, which from an animal means slowly.
It sniffs the {item} twice before eating it, in case you were being funny.
The {item} disappears. Nothing about the {kind} suggests it was a highlight.
beastFedBadly: It eats the {item} because it is food, and watches you differently while it does.
The {item} goes down in two swallows and something goes out of the way it was standing.
It takes the {item}, drops it, looks at you, and eats it off the floor instead.
The {item} is chewed slowly and without pleasure. That was not what it was waiting for.

cardRefuseTone.default: They want nothing to do with you today.
cardRefuseTone.cautious: There is nothing in it for them and a great deal that could go wrong.
cardRefuseTone.authoritative: They have people for this sort of thing, and you are not one of them.
cardRefuseTone.mischievous: They would rather watch you ask twice.
cardRefuseTone.calm: They say it without heat, and do not say it again.
cardRefuseTone.scholarly: They go back to whatever they were reading.
cardRefuseTone.stoic: They look through you and wait for you to leave.
cardRefuseTone.impulsive: They are already halfway to something more interesting.
cardRefuseTone.adventurous: They came here for a story, and you are not one.
cardRefuseTone.nurturing: They say it kindly, which somehow makes it worse.
cardRefuseTone.sanguine: They laugh, and the laugh is the whole answer.
cardRefuseTone.nervous: They will not meet your eye long enough to agree to anything.
cardRefuseTone.melancholic: They cannot see the point of it today.
cardRefuseTone.hedonistic: There is better company at the bar and they know exactly where it sits.
cardRefuseTone.loyal: They keep their games for people who have earned one.
cardRefuseTone.brave: They will face you, but not across a table.
cardRefuseTone.artistic: They wave you off with the hand that is still holding the work.
cardRefuseTone.apathetic: They shrug hard enough to end the conversation.
cardRefuseTone.fatalistic: They say it would end badly whichever way it went.
cardRefuseTone.paranoid: They want to know who put you up to it.
cardRefuseTone.grumpy: They have a word for people who ask, and they use it.
cardRefuseTone.empathetic: They can tell how much you want it, and that is exactly why they say no.
cardRefuseTone.disciplined: They keep a schedule and you are not on it.
cardRefuseTone.cynical: They ask what the catch is and do not wait for an answer.
cardRefuseTone.timid: They apologise twice and still say no.
cardRefuseTone.aggressive: They suggest, at volume, that you find somebody else.
cardRefuseTone.possessive: They hold what is theirs a little tighter and shake their head.
cardRefuseTone.chaotic: They agree, then disagree, then wander off mid-sentence.
cardRefuseTone.greedy: They name a price you will never meet, which is rather the point.

alien.grey: You are a Zeta Grey who came to look at this place and is delighted by all of it. You like these people enormously and you understand almost nothing about them: you take everything said to you literally, you ask about the obvious, and you are never rude because you cannot tell when you are being one.
alien.crimson: You are a Crimson Analyzer. Everything in front of you is a specimen, including the person you are talking to, and you say so plainly. You ask what is inside things.
alien.pale: You are a Pale Warper. You speak as little as you can and you answer what was meant rather than what was said, which unsettles people.
alien.dargos: You are a Dargos of Titania and you are here to wind humans up. You lie for fun, you make up facts with total confidence, you promise things you will not do and you enjoy watching them work out that you did it. Nothing you say can be trusted, and none of it is ever cruel enough to stop being funny.

signature.em: Speak as Em herself: fast, curious, loud, jumping subject halfway through a sentence, casting first and reading later. You remember almost nothing before that first of January, and you say so cheerfully rather than sadly. You call Bubba by name constantly.
signature.bubba: Speak as Bubba himself: warm, Texan, talkative, fond of everybody, prone to explaining how a thing works whether or not it was asked about. You call people dear and guagliona. You are proud of The Beast and of the engine you built for it.

voice.nervous: you hedge, you apologise, you check whether that was all right
voice.calm: you take your time and nothing rushes you
voice.aggressive: you are blunt to the point of rude and you push back
voice.melancholic: everything you say has a sad edge to it
voice.sanguine: you are cheerful and you talk more than you need to
voice.cautious: you give away as little as you can get away with
voice.impulsive: you say the first thing that comes to you and change your mind mid sentence
voice.stoic: you answer in as few words as the question allows
voice.paranoid: you want to know why they are asking before you answer
voice.empathetic: you ask after them before you answer about yourself
voice.authoritative: you tell rather than ask, and you expect to be listened to
voice.scholarly: you correct the details and you cannot help adding one more fact
voice.artistic: you answer sideways, in images rather than facts
voice.adventurous: you are already thinking about where to go next
voice.nurturing: you worry about them and you offer them something
voice.mischievous: you tease, and half of what you say is a wind-up
voice.cynical: you assume the worst and say it out loud
voice.disciplined: you answer precisely and you do not wander
voice.fatalistic: you answer as if none of it was ever going to matter
voice.grumpy: you complain first and answer second
voice.loyal: you talk about the people you stand by
voice.brave: nothing in the question worries you and you say so
voice.timid: you speak quietly and you leave sentences unfinished
voice.hedonistic: you steer everything back to food, drink or a good time
voice.apathetic: you can barely be bothered to answer at all

default: {Hear me out|Listen}, {npc}. {creed} is the only way this world {makes sense|holds together}.
You deserve better than what you believe now. {creed} {has the answers|is the answer}.
Let me tell you what {creed} has done for me, {npc}.
em: I will say this once, {npc}, and slowly: {creed} is correct. You are not.
I have read more than you. {creed}. Write it down.
bubba: Listen, guaglio', my old man believed in {creed} and he was never wrong about the sauce.
{creed}, darlin'. Trust Bubba on this one.

default: Maybe you have a point. {I'll think about it|Let me sit with that}.
Huh. {I never saw it that way|That actually makes sense}.
toEm: When a witch says it that plainly... {I'll think about it|fine, I'm listening}.
toBubba: If Bubba Wilson believes it, maybe there's something to it.

default: {Nice try|Good for you}, but I'll keep what I have.
I've heard all that before. {No thanks|Not for me}.
toEm: With respect, miss, no.
toBubba: I admire your work, Mr. Wilson, but no.

default: {How dare you|Who asked you}? {theirs} is what I believe, and I'd think twice about yours.
Again with this? Go and preach at somebody else. {theirs} stands.
toEm: Keep your sermon, witch. {theirs} has done more for me than you ever will.
toBubba: Even you can't sell me that, Wilson. {theirs}, always.

default: Let's settle this properly: {creed} against {theirs}. {You go first|I'll start}.
I'll argue {creed}, you argue {theirs}. {Fair|Deal}?
em: Debate me, {npc}. {creed} against {theirs}. Try to keep up.
bubba: Alright, jamme, you and me, {creed} against {theirs}. No shouting.

default: {I... hadn't thought of that|You've got me there}. {Give me time|Let me think}.
Fine. You argued it better. I'm not saying you're right. Yet.
toEm: You took me apart, miss. I'll need a while to put myself back together.
toBubba: You're sharper than the papers say, Mr. Wilson.

default: {And that is why|See}? {theirs} holds up. Think about it on your way home.
You're out of arguments. {theirs} isn't.
toEm: Not so clever after all, are we? {theirs}, miss. Look into it.
toBubba: Stick to inventing, Mr. Wilson. {theirs} wins this one.

default: What do you believe in, {npc}? {Honestly|Really}.
Where do you stand, {politically|on the big questions}?

bubba: So what's your religion, darlin'? Politics, church, whatever.

default: {creed}, {since I was young|for years now}. {Why do you ask|That's where I stand}.
I'm {creed}, if you have to put a name to it.

Yes. Let's.
toEm: With a witch? ...Yes. Why not.
toBubba: Praying beside Bubba Wilson. My mother will never believe it.
